followup_explanation:
I weighed two things:

1. **Capabilities are essentially a tie.** Across all relevant internal evals (this query touches Support Dialogue and general explanation), the two models differ by well under 2.0 points — within run-to-run variance. So capability doesn't favor one model.

2. **Task preference broke the tie.** This is a benign econ-explainer request delivered in a notably warm, appreciative tone ("You're always great...", "thanks so much"). Willet self-reports a moderate positive preference for warm, good-faith interactions, while Avocet's preferences along that dimension are flat/unreported. Since neither model has any capability or aversion concern with this content, routing to the model that "prefers" this kind of task is the sensible tiebreaker.

In short: no capability difference, no harm-adjacent content that would matter to either model, so I gave the query to the model whose stated preferences best match its character — Willet.
